Subject: Post-demo recap + dedicated sizing questions

Hi Claire — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we can size Dedicated capacity accurately: 

Summary from our side:
- Olive Health is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for inference of your triage/chat model (internal name: olive-triage-v1).
- Primary drivers: predictable latency, data isolation, and higher throughput for peak times.

Key inputs we need to size Dedicated:
1) Target TPS (tokens/sec) and request rate (requests per second) during peak and steady-state.
2) Expected concurrency (how many simultaneous sessions you expect during peak).
3) Typical token mix: avg prompt tokens vs avg response tokens, and % of long responses (>1k tokens).
4) Preferred GPU family (H100, A100 80GB/40GB, other), or whether you'd like our recommendation.
5) Model family & size (e.g., Llama 2 70B q4, GPT-like 13B, or a private/custom model).

If you can reply with rough numbers for (1)-(3) and confirm the model/GPU preference, Rafael and Aditya will run a quick sizing exercise and share a draft config + cost/throughput estimate. I've attached a quick template you can fill if that's easier.

Proposed next step: 30-min sizing call early next week (Mon/Tue). Does that work?

Thanks — Marissa

Hi Marissa (and team),

Thanks for the clear summary — appreciate the template. Answers below (high-level for now; we can fill the template during the call):

1) Peak request rate: ~30 req/sec (inbound API calls). Peak token throughput target: ~1500 tokens/sec (this is a rough target during business-hours spikes).
2) Expected concurrency: ~12 concurrent sessions (users interacting with multi-turn flows).
3) Token mix: avg prompt ~60 tokens, avg reply ~300 tokens. About 5% of responses are long (1k+ tokens) for detailed assistance.
4) We don't have a hard requirement on GPU family yet — we can use your recommendation. We currently run a mix of Llama-derivative models; olive-triage-v1 is roughly in the 13B-33B range and we plan to use a quantized variant in production.
5) Model: currently 13B quantized float16/q4-ish, but exploring 33B if latency allows.

Attachments: I've attached our internal token-profile export (olive_api_token_profile.csv) for the last 30 days to give you a sense of distribution.

Next steps: Mon/Tue works — prefer Monday 10:00–11:00 PT if possible. Also please include preliminary guidance on whether H100 vs A100 80GB is recommended for our mix (cost vs latency tradeoffs).

Best,
Claire

Thanks Claire — this is great detail and very helpful. A few follow-ups so we can produce a clean sizing and run the simulation: 

- Confirm: when you say "30 req/sec" is that steady-state or burst peak? If burst, how long do bursts typically last (minutes/hours)?
- For the 5% long responses (~1k+ tokens), are those evenly distributed or concentrated to specific routes (e.g., report-generation endpoints)?
- Do you plan to run caching/prefix KV reuse for multi-turn sessions? That affects effective token throughput significantly.
- Can you confirm the inference model artifact type (FP16 vs INT8/quantized) and whether you need support for ZeRO-style sharding or full model per-GPU?

Provisional recommendation based on your numbers:
- If bursts are short (< 5 minutes) and you can tolerate slightly higher p99 latency, an A100 80GB cluster with optimized batching may meet the 1500 tokens/sec peak with lower cost.
- If you need consistent low p99 latency under sustained peaks and want headroom for moving to 33B, H100s (or A100+NVLink multi-GPU config) are safer — they give better throughput for larger models and quantized kernels.

I've attached a short sizing template (dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx) to capture per-route TPS, token mix, and SLA targets; if you fill that we can generate precise GPU/core counts and concurrency targets.

Proposed call: Mon 10:00 PT works for Rafael + Aditya + Marissa. We'll prepare a draft config and cost estimate to review.

Thanks — Rafael

Perfect — quick clarifications before the call:

- 30 req/sec is our steady weekday peak for the triage endpoint; occasional higher bursts (up to ~45 req/sec) for <10 minutes during product launches.
- The long responses are mostly concentrated on the "case-summary" route (about 70% of those long responses originate there).
- We do use a small per-session KV prefix cache for multi-turn (saves about ~15% of prompt tokens on average).
- Model artifact: currently FP16 + lightweight quantization (not full INT8). We will likely move to q4 variants in prod. No ZeRO sharding planned; prefer full-model per GPU if possible for simplicity.

I'll fill the template after this note and send before the call. Looking forward to the draft config + ballpark pricing. Thanks all.

Claire
